_comment: Quests. Each has stages in order; a stage is finished by talking to someone (an 'advance' choice in content/people/people.json, which takes the stage's needs from the bag) or by a world flag (done_when). target points the HUD: 'person:<id>', 'ruin', or ''. Names are placeholders.

stages.text: Go into the echo ruin south of the plaza, and wake what sleeps there.
Tell Elder Teshwa what happened in the ruin.
Bring Maru 4 raw meat. Redstriders graze the grass around the village.
Bring Dael 8 flint. Flint nodules lie on rocky ground; gather them with E.
